The '''Quarantine Zone''' was the name given to a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vault located in the [[Maximum Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located in the [[Isolation Area]], it was designated a quarantine zone because of the toxic gas that filled the vault. It was the site of a Rakatan "superhub" machine that was overseen by Warden [[Gorshaa]].
